messages:
tanya: Need a compact "FastStart Runtime Checklist" one-pager for customers — focused on onboarding checks (cache/batch/stream), quick diagnostics, and 3 renewal signals. Keep it customer-facing and runnable.

rick: Love it. Suggested bullets to show customers:
- Edge caching: TTL 20-60s depending on freshness needs. Test hit rate after 48h.
- Client batching: group rapid UI actions (batch 4-6), flush 25-100ms.
- Streaming: use for chat UX; add fallback after 300-500ms stall.

mel: Add 3 quick runnable snippets:
1) Pre-warm cron (curl): `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"welcome","max_tokens":8}'`
2) Validation harness (bash): `for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"sanity","max_tokens":32}'; done` — capture median latency.
3) JS batcher (concept):
```
let q=[]; setInterval(()=>{if(!q.length)return; const b=q.splice(0,6); fetch('/api/batch',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify(b)})},50)
```

tanya: Renewal signals to surface in week-1 dashboard: cache hit rate, median token cost per session, and streaming fallback frequency. If token cost/session rises >25% week-over-week, trigger CS triage.

rick: Troubleshooting FAQ to give customers: Did you pin model version? Are prefixes tokenized identically? Are requests unexpectedly routed cross-region? Provide one-click support link.

mel: Feedback capture idea: a 1-click "helpful" at stream end + anonymized prompt head logging (first 4 tokens) so product can see failing prompts without PII.

cs-bot: Reminder: create Drive doc "FastStart Runtime Checklist" and assign reviewers tanya, rick, mel.

tanya: Great. I'll assemble the one-pager for kickoff templates and recommend sending to medium-risk renewals in week 2 for proactive check-in. :rocket:
